name: Dim Palm
description: Strike with a palm wrapped in thin darkness that dulls the target's sight of the blow.

name: Shade Guard
description: Draw a layer of shadow over the forearms to soften a blow and hide the arm's movement.

name: Dusk Step
description: Step from one patch of shade to the next so the body seems to slip between two moments of dimness.

name: Murk Jab
description: Snap a short jab out of a clouded hand so the knuckles land before the eye can follow.

name: Gloam Cloak
description: Wear a thin cloak of gloom that quiets the footfalls and gives the next strikes the edge of surprise.

name: Dark Reading
description: Still the eyes and let dark qi feel out the shapes and motion of those standing near in unlit air.

name: Hush Step
description: Place each foot so the sole swallows its own sound and the body glides forward without noise.

name: Soft Black
description: Throw a muffled blow that lands without the crack of impact and gives the foe no warning sound.

name: Mute Veil
description: Hang a veil of muffling dark before the chest so a thrust slides aside and its sound dies.

name: Still Breath
description: Hold the breath inside a pocket of dark qi so no sign of the student leaves the body.

name: Hush Pall
description: Lay a hush of dark qi over one foe's ears so shouts and footsteps blur together for a moment.

name: Quiet Elbow
description: Drive the elbow into the ribs at close range with the sound of the blow swallowed by dark qi.

name: Umbral Ear
description: Spread dark qi thin along the floor and read the footfalls of others from its faint shivers.

name: Banked Shade
description: Gather a small store of shade under the skin and keep it ready to feed the next guard or step.

name: Shade Plate
description: Spend the stored shade in one thick sheet before the body to blunt a cut or a thrown stone.

name: Sable Hop
description: Hop one pace sideways into the foe's blind angle with a trail of shade covering the move.

name: Shade Lash
description: Flick a lash of shade from the fingers that stings the face and makes the eyes close.

name: Shade Tug
description: Pull the nearby light down toward the hands until the foe's grip on a weapon grows uncertain.

name: Blind Stride
description: Take a long stride through dim ground guided by dark qi alone with the eyes held half closed.

name: Feeler Dark
description: Send threads of dark qi ahead along the ground to learn where walls and sleepers and edges lie.

name: Gloom Shove
description: Push both palms forward on a wave of gloom that staggers the foe and hides the follow-up.

name: Dusk Guard
description: Turn a blow aside with a forearm clouded in dusk so the attacker misjudges where the arm is.

name: Pitch Heel
description: Spin on the ball of the foot and drive a heel of pitch-dark qi into the thigh.

name: Slip Dark
description: Drop low and slide under a reaching arm while a cloud of dark qi covers the slide.

name: Umbra Bead
description: Pinch a bead of condensed darkness and flick it at the target to sting like a thrown pebble.

name: Umbra Disc
description: Spin a flat disc of darkness in the palm and skim it low across the shins of the foe.

name: Umbra Pull
description: Draw the darkness back from a target and rein it in again so the foe's limbs feel suddenly heavy.

name: Black Shell
description: Wrap darkness into a hard shell around the forearm and take a blow on its curved face.

name: Umbra Whip
description: Cast out a long thin rope of darkness and crack it across the target's arm.

name: Umbra Seal
description: Pinch a patch of darkness over a lamp or a glowing talisman so it gives no light for a breath.

name: Umbra Skip
description: Skip forward on a flung ball of darkness and land with the weight already set behind a blow.

name: Umbra Fist
description: Close the hand on a lump of packed darkness and punch so the dark carries into the body.

name: Dim Eyes
description: Lower the light round one foe's eyes by a fraction so shapes at range run together.

name: Dim Self
description: Lower the light about the body so the outline fades into the background and eyes slide past.

name: Dim Blow
description: Throw a straight blow from inside a dimmed patch so the foe misjudges the distance by a hand.

name: Dim Brace
description: Set a dimmed shield of qi before the chest that hides the guard and blunts light blows.

name: Dim Slide
description: Slide to the side inside a fading patch of light so the foe strikes at the place left behind.

name: Dim Scan
description: Dim the room a little and watch which glows and shapes give themselves away against the dark.

name: Pall Spread
description: Spread a low pall of dark qi across the ground so the foes lose their footing marks and gauge.

name: Cloak Blur
description: Wear the pall close about the body as a cloak that blurs the outline of the arms and legs.

name: Pall Strike
description: Strike out of the cloak so the fist appears from a haze with no sign of its start.

name: Cloak Fold
description: Fold the edge of the cloak over a thrust and let it slide off along the wrapped dark.

name: Pall Drift
description: Drift behind the lifting pall to a new spot a few paces away while the foe still guards the old one.

name: Empty Palm
description: Open the palm over an empty dark centre and push so the blow pulls light in as it lands.

name: Umbral Cup
description: Cup both hands before the body round a pocket of dark that swallows the sting of a thrown stone.

name: Empty Step
description: Step into an empty dark pocket and out of it a pace away with the sound of the move taken.

name: Taken Light
description: Pull the glow from a lantern or a talisman into the open hand and leave the foe in a dark spot.

name: Unseen Cloak
description: Open a small dark space round the body from which the next few moves come out unseen.

name: Empty Pulse
description: Push a pulse of emptiness from the palm that dims everything in a narrow line for an instant.

name: Warmth Mark
description: Let the empty dark pocket catch the faint warmth and motion of every living body within it.
